title: viola palmata var. pedatifida
intro: Viola palmata var. pedatifida, commonly known as the Yellow Wood Sorrel, is a type of flowering plant that belongs to the Violet family (Violaceae). This plant is known for its health benefits, which include its ability to act as a natural diuretic, helping to reduce fluid retention and alleviate symptoms of urinary tract infections. The therapeutic actions of Viola palmata var. pedatifida include its antimicrobial and anti-inflammatory properties, which may help to soothe skin irritations and reduce pain. The bioactive constituents of this plant include ascorbic acid, flavonoids, and tannins, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
